comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from parts vs seat a shower cartridge and install its retaining clip.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and bridge-clearing agitation vs hold a spring-backed cartridge flush and square while inserting a U-clip.
comparison.success_condition: ≥98% media in receiver, all washers in screen, no loss, screen released on supports vs cartridge and clip fully seated, retention proven under 20 N pull, hands clear.
comparison.reason: This is granular separation rather than force-opposed alignment and clip insertion.
